notes: SILENT PRINT (mute 台影新聞 newsreel; the file's track is blank hiss). Taipei, Dec 1967, the National Science Education Hall on Nanhai Road: the exhibition banner, the crowd at the IBM stand, a woman typing at a printing terminal; an NEC picture-phone with a woman's face on its screen and a woman on the handset watching it; then the long hold, schoolboys crowding the handsets, an AMPEX video recorder and TV monitor, a 3M motion-picture camera, reel-to-reel decks, a man at a bench of scopes before a wall of monitors, the Chiao Tung University stand, girls making trunk calls at the STC booth; last a synchronous-satellite model, a tape deck, and a panel of concentric-ring moiré diagrams of two sound sources.
